q1_issues.issue: The locative restriction is encoded by nesting the whole categorical atom inside In — a nesting the framing-PP rule never shows — so the illegality claim is never asserted at top level and "is prostitution illegal?" cannot bind, where the instruction set's route for a locative restriction on a kind-level property is the ConditionalProperty condition slot ("Trailers are permitted on the causeway").

q2_gaps: concessive / contrastive "while" ("While X is illegal, Y is legal" = "although") — "while" appears only in the list of TEMPORAL connectives that get no connective atom, and the concessive list names only although / even though / despite, so nothing says which rule wins
a kind-level property restricted to a jurisdiction or place ("prostitution is illegal in Canada") — no rule chooses between the framing-PP In, LocatedIn, and the ConditionalProperty condition slot

a participial / adjectival post-modifier taking a PP complement ("activities related to prostitution") — the reduced-relative rule demands an ordinary event form and forbids a participle-named head, while the symmetric-predicate license would give exactly (Related $x prostitution) + (Symmetric Related); the instruction set does not adjudicate
notes: The restricted copular universal correctly takes the Implication form with a Member conclusion at strength 0.9 plus its QuantifierPhrase companion, matching the "everyone who owns a dog is a pet owner" pattern. Related is defensible as the open-class Symmetric-tagged relation, since (Symmetric Related) is emitted beside it.
